results.evidence: I ran migrate, then log-inbound against a fresh database in $TMPDIR. The first inquiry used --phone "(801) 555-0134" --scope "lobby refresh" --budget 25000 --location "Murray, UT" --company "Acme Holdings" (plus the required --channel form, --received and --segment commercial). Lead 1 stores project_scope 'lobby refresh', value_amount 25000, value_basis 'buyer-stated', property_location 'Murray, UT' and organization_id 1. Organization 1 is named 'Acme Holdings'. Contact 1 has phone_e164 '+18015550134'. A second inquiry with --company "ACME holdings" (I added --name Bob, because the command requires at least one of name, email or phone) created lead 2, which reuses organization_id 1. The organizations table still holds one row. Caveats: sqlite3 shows value_amount as 25000, and I did not check its stored type (text or number), so 'value_amount 25000' is read as the value only. The channel value is 'form', not 'website-form'.

I ran the real CLI against a fresh DB in $TMPDIR. I logged two inquiries. The first had every field: name, email, phone, company, location, scope, budget 12345.50 and --test. The second was a phone inquiry with only a name. The activities table then had exactly one inquiry_logged row per lead, with lead_id 1 and 2. The payloads were {"channel":"form","segment":"commercial","is_test":true,"duplicate_of":[]} and {"channel":"phone","segment":"unknown","is_test":false,"duplicate_of":[]}. Neither payload contains the name, email, phone, scope or budget values. The payload is built from only channel, segment, is_test and duplicate_of (cottonwood/inbound.py, log_inquiry). The insert sits in the same transaction as the lead insert, with no second activity insert. tests/test_inbound.py passed (25 passed), including test_one_inquiry_logged_activity_without_personal_data.

Ran against a fresh migrated DB in $TMPDIR. Five invalid invocations each exited 2 (argparse): missing --received, missing --channel, missing --segment, --channel email, --segment industrial. leads count was 0 afterwards. Then `log-inbound --name Bob --channel form --segment residential --received 2026-11-16T16:30:00Z` exited 0 and stored received_at = 2026-11-16T16:30:00Z (count 1). Without a contact field the command exits 1 and writes nothing, which is a separate rule and does not affect this AC. cli.py:98-109 has required=True and choices on the three flags.

I migrated a fresh DB in $TMPDIR, then ran `python -m cottonwood log-inbound` with each bad input. Every run exited 1 with a stderr message naming the field. Invalid email: 'error: email: email must contain exactly one @'. Invalid phone: 'error: phone: US numbers must have 10 digits'. Budget abc: 'error: budget: not a decimal number'. Budget -5: 'error: budget: must not be negative'. Unparseable --received: 'error: received: expected YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM ...'. No name/email/phone: 'error: name/email/phone: supply at least one of --name, --email, --phone'. Afterwards leads, contacts, organizations and activities each had count 0. cli.py validates the inquiry (lines 150-155) before it opens the DB, so a refusal returns EXIT_REFUSED before anything is written.

I migrated a fresh DB under $TMPDIR and ran `cottonwood log-inbound --channel form --received '2026-03-01 10:00' --segment unknown --email ...` twice. Without --test it printed 'logged inquiry lead 1 (form, unknown, received 2026-03-01 10:00 -07:00)', with no TEST. With --test it printed '... -07:00) TEST'. Both runs exited 0. `select id,is_test from leads` returned 1|0 and 2|1. cottonwood/cli.py:168 adds ' TEST' only when inquiry.is_test is true, and inbound.py:196 stores 1 or 0. I did not run the test suite.

In the worktree with UV_OFFLINE=1 UV_NO_SYNC=1: `uv run pytest` exited 0 with 175 passed. `uv run ruff check .` printed 'All checks passed!'. `uv run mypy .` printed 'Success: no issues found in 28 source files'. `uv run ruff format --check .` printed '83 files already formatted'. My first attempt quoted each command as a single string, which failed to spawn. That was my invocation error, so I re-ran the three tool commands unquoted and they passed.
